subject.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-sonnet-5 to bundled model catalog and GA-1M prefix lists

question: Should maintainers use this PR as the canonical Claude Sonnet 5 rollout, or hold it behind the broader overlapping rollout at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98254?
rationale: Both open branches cover the same model family and touch compatibility-sensitive provider and SDK surfaces, so automation should not choose the permanent provider contract direction on its own.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Proceed with this branch after maintainer provider/API review and exact-head required checks confirm the current payload and reasoning semantics.

options.title: Use the broader rollout instead
options.body: Pause or close this PR if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98254 is the intended canonical Sonnet 5 implementation.

options.title: Ask for a narrower split
options.body: Require the catalog/context fix to land separately from broader provider reasoning contract changes if maintainers want lower upgrade risk.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Proceed with this branch after maintainer provider/API review and exact-head required checks confirm the current payload and reasoning semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and authored the latest maintainer-expanded commits on the provider/model routing behavior under review.
